:::{#exm-ci-mean}

#### Confidence interval for the mean birthweight of 40-week males

For the `birthweight` model with an interaction (`bw_lm2`),
the code below applies @thm-ci-mean at sex male and gestational age 40 weeks,
and compares the result with the interval from `predict(interval = "confidence")`:

```{r}
#| label: exm-ci-mean-calc
#| code-fold: show
ex_new <- data.frame(sex = "male", age = 40)
ex_pred <- predict(bw_lm2, newdata = ex_new, se.fit = TRUE)
ex_tcrit <- qt(0.975, df = bw_lm2$df.residual)
ex_ci <- ex_pred$fit + c(-1, 1) * ex_tcrit * ex_pred$se.fit
ex_ci_predict <- predict(bw_lm2, newdata = ex_new, interval = "confidence")
```

The estimated mean is `r round(ex_pred$fit, 1)` grams,
with 95% confidence interval
(`r round(ex_ci[1], 1)`, `r round(ex_ci[2], 1)`).
The interval from `predict()` is
(`r round(ex_ci_predict[, "lwr"], 1)`, `r round(ex_ci_predict[, "upr"], 1)`),
which agrees.

:::
